name: canvas
enchant_note: Sailcloth is made to be cheap and tough, not to hold a spell.
protection_note: Canvas is sailcloth: tough, light and cheap.
protection_price: Catches fire, and fire scorches it.
lore_descriptor: heavy and cream-colored, stiff to the touch
first_pickup_chronicle: Pulled on a canvas jack. Sailors and soldiers both swore by the stuff, and it shrugged off the first knife I met. Good enough for me.
